slides.title: The 5-bin declutter method for people who can't decide what to keep
Why decluttering freezes us
slides.body: Every object asks 'keep or not?' and our brains spiral into 'but what if'. Bins make the decision for you.

slides.title: The Maybe bin is the secret
slides.body: Can't decide in 5 seconds? Maybe bin. No spiraling. Tape it shut, write a date 30 days out.

slides.title: If you didn't open it, let it go
slides.body: When the date comes and you didn't need anything inside, donate it without reopening. Future you already decided.

slides.title: One shelf, not one room
slides.body: Start with one shelf or one drawer. A room is too big. A shelf is a win you can finish.

slides.title: Keeping something 'in case' costs space, time and brain. Every single day.
Declutter without the decision fatigue
slides.body: The full 5-bin method is inside The Messy Brain Home Reset. Link in bio.
